literal_meaning: শীর্ষে বা উচ্চতায় বৃহস্পতি (Jupiter at the peak)
similar_in_english: Lady Luck is smiling on you
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার তুঙ্গে বৃহস্পতি, লটারিতে জিতে গেল।
এই বছর তোমার তুঙ্গে বৃহস্পতি, সব শুভ কাজ হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has Jupiter at its peak; he won the lottery.
This year, your Jupiter is high; everything will turn out auspicious.
history: Derived from Hindu astrology, where Brihaspati (Jupiter) symbolizes wisdom, prosperity, and good fortune; the idiom implies one's planetary luck is at its zenith.
note: References the benevolent influence of the planet Jupiter in traditional Bengali astrological beliefs.
